process() returns error when config language is unknown

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    try {
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"nonexistent_xyz\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("x = 1", config)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
